M-LINT-PROVIDERS.NAME: External lint providers
M-LINT-PROVIDERS.purpose: Run optional trust-gated external scanners in lint/ci and adapt their JSON to coded MyGRACE findings (ADR-11).

fn-runLintProviders.PURPOSE: Authorize, execute and audit every enabled provider; never throws on provider failure.

fn-adaptLegacyScan.PURPOSE: Flatten Modern Web Guidance legacy-scan JSON into findings.

fn-adaptJsonFindings.PURPOSE: Generic adapter for scanners emitting an array or {findings}.

type-LintProviderRun.PURPOSE: Per-provider execution summary for the JSON data payload.

CrossLink.relation: shared trust gate, tokenizer, deny list and audit log

contract.purpose: Run optional trust-gated external scanners in lint/ci and adapt their JSON to coded MyGRACE findings (ADR-11).

param.name: root
param.description: Project root; provider commands run with this cwd.

param.name: config
param.description: lintProviders entries, allowCommands and trust inputs.

param.name: report
param.description: Authorization, per-provider runs and adapted findings.

error.description: Commands are untrusted; nothing was executed.
Dangerous command pattern; nothing was executed.
Provider output is not valid JSON for its adapter.

notes.note-1: Provider findings default to warning; failOn error/warning/none controls severity.
notes.note-2: Every invocation is appended to .mygrace/audit.log; external output is parsed as data, never executed.
notes.note-3: Unpinned provider commands are reported as LINT_PROVIDER_UNPINNED; trust records hash the config.
notes.note-4: Providers are opt-in via config; the core lint gate stays deterministic and offline.
